originality.rationale: The target is the labeled F_q point count in every joint (rank X, rank Y, common-kernel dimension) stratum of V(n,2,2). Geometric component/shape classifications do not themselves specify these rational-point multiplicities. Broad AB=BA=0 totals include many non-square-zero pairs and cannot recover conditioned triple frequencies by summing. A historical explicit formula remains a residual risk.
residual_risks: An older finite-field enumeration of the same conditional rank/kernel strata may be indexed under radical-square-zero module counting or orbit-table terminology.

Bleher et al. provide geometric parametrizations close to a counting argument; although no triple formula is stated, a specialist may consider the arithmetic refinement a direct extension of that framework.

value.rationale: Determines the complete finite-field rank/socle arithmetic spectrum of a canonical two-loop radical-square-zero matrix variety in all dimensions and fields. It refines established Jordan-pair feasibility and component theorems with exact counts, a sharp common-kernel cutoff, and an independent total generating count. The object and invariants arise naturally in representation theory rather than from an arbitrary finite slice.
